author_constraints: D07 is a Violet-ending dungeon in the Blue political Domain. Domain identity and deepest dungeon stratum are separate concepts.
Phase 1 depth bands: Red 0–1.5, Orange 1.5–3.5, Yellow 3.5–6.5, Green 6.5–11, Blue 11–17, Violet 17–24 miles.
Use the established D01–D06 mapping system and consistent data, rendering and explorer conventions.
One persistent 3D graph supplies every projection; changing views does not generate new geography.
design_proposals: Principal E-W widths, N-S placement envelopes, node counts, terminal-arm allocations and link counts are design proposals for D07.
The preserved best-candidate placement, Delaunay-pruning, depth-correlation, lateral-chain and four-vertex passage algorithms are retained.
One primary entrance at local R001 (0,0,0); use (D07,node_id) for global identity.
The deepest principal node is fixed at 24 miles in Violet. All six strata Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue and Violet are included.
Seed 1630701 and the source implementation are frozen for D07 revision001. Permanent IDs are assigned once.
